description: Phase-MODERNIZE Wave C — Dedup. userStories.title: Extract internal/api error-handling helper — kill ~6+ api dupl cluster
userStories.description: Top dupl cluster per stale 2026-05-14 report is the os.ErrNotExist + Logger.Warn + 500 boilerplate repeated in internal/api/sources.go (4 sites at lines ~55-63, 94-102, 115-123, 231-239), internal/api/sources_write.go (3 sites), internal/api/skills.go, internal/api/swarm.go, internal/api/tasks.go. Line numbers may have shifted post-Wave A; consult .planning/dupl-report-2026-05-22.txt (from DEDUP-00) for current line refs. (a) Read 2-3 representative sites to confirm the exact pattern. (b) Create internal/api/error_helpers.go with `writeReadError(w http.ResponseWriter, deps Deps, err error, opName, id string)` — handles the `if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) { 404 } else { Logger.Warn + 500 }` pattern. (c) Update every duplicate call site to use the helper. (d) Run dupl -t 60 ./internal/api after the change — the largest api cluster MUST be reduced from 9 to ≤3. (e) go test ./internal/api/... -count=1 green.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/api/error_helpers.go (or equivalent) exports writeReadError or similar single-shot helper
≥6 call sites in internal/api updated to use the new helper (verified via git diff line count showing ≥50 lines deleted from the duplicated blocks)

Single atomic commit prefix: refactor(api): extract writeReadError helper — kill os.ErrNotExist dupl (US-MOD-DEDUP-01)

userStories.title: Consolidate config/store.go Get* fallback pattern — fold to parseOrFallback helper
userStories.description: internal/config/store.go has the same 8-line `v, err := s.Get(ctx, key); if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(v) == "" { return fallback }; parsed, err := parse(v); if err != nil { return fallback }; return parsed` pattern in GetInt (line 128-138), GetFloat (line ~142-152), GetBool (line ~156-166). Extract: `parseOrFallback[T any](ctx, key string, fallback T, parser func(string) (T, error)) T` — non-generic-typed helper if generics complicate, two-step `getTrimmed(ctx, key)` + per-type parser composition works too. Fold GetInt/GetFloat/GetBool to a single call site each. Tests in internal/config/store_test.go (if existing) stay green; if no test exists for these, the dupl reduction itself proves correctness.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/config/store.go has a single parseOrFallback (or getTrimmed) helper used by GetInt + GetFloat + GetBool
Each Get* function body ≤4 lines (down from 11)
dupl -t 60 ./internal/config/... reports 0 clusters in store.go for the Get* triple
go test ./internal/config/... -count=1 green
golangci-lint clean on touched files
Single atomic commit prefix: refactor(config): fold GetInt/GetFloat/GetBool via parseOrFallback helper (US-MOD-DEDUP-02)
userStories.notes: PRECONDITION: DEDUP-00 done. Generic helper preferred for Go 1.21+; fallback to per-type duplication-of-just-one-line if generics make the call site uglier.

userStories.title: Final pass — top-N residual production dupl clusters per fresh report
userStories.description: After DEDUP-00..03 land, run `dupl -t 60 ./...` again and identify the next 2-3 largest PRODUCTION dupl clusters (skip *_test.go). For each, attempt one extraction iff: (a) the dupe block is ≥10 lines, (b) the call sites are all in one or two packages (no new cross-package dep edge), (c) the helper signature is obvious from the duplicated block (no design judgment required). If a cluster fails any of those gates, document it in docs/dupl-summary-2026-05-22.md with a one-sentence note and SKIP. Commit ONLY the extractions that pass all 3 gates.
